activities.title: Props Inspector
activities.instruction: Match each prop to the value received by the child component.

content.concept: Understand that props allow parent components to pass data into child components.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Component Composition
activities.instruction: Arrange reusable components to construct a complete page section.

content.concept: Compose larger interfaces by nesting smaller reusable React components.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Children Slot
activities.instruction: Place different JSX content inside a reusable Card component's children slot.

content.concept: Understand how the special children prop lets a component render nested JSX supplied by its parent.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Props Debugger
activities.instruction: Identify the mismatched prop name that prevents the child component from displaying the expected value.

content.concept: Debug prop-name mismatches between parent and child components.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
